title: Chapter 686
paragraphs: Chapter 686
Episode 175. The Oath (2)
"Lord Zephyrin is here!"
"The Grand Duke is here, sister!"
At the Kinzelo headquarters, Bubar and Ainas welcomed the three executives who had just returned with their bright voices.
Zephyrin, Bianca, and Lanke. The three of them had escaped from the space while Jin and Bale were battling, so naturally, their mood was not so good.
Especially, Zephyrin was enraged by the fact that she had been 'toyed with' by Jin again.
Moreover, this time it wasn't even Jin who had devised a strategy, but she just followed him and suffered a loss, which annoyed her even more.
"Anyway, it's true that I always get tired when I get involved with Jin Runcandel. Ah, this is so annoying."
There were two main reasons why Kinzelo chose to retreat rather than join the battle.
The first is that Zephyrin couldn't use the power of the leader, and the second is to reduce the loss of force.
She thought Jin wouldn't die at the hands of that madman who kept calling for Sarah, so there was no need to help that despicable human by going to extremes. This was Zephyrin's judgement.
"Grand Duke... But... this time... Jin Runcandel... helped us... He... tore the space."

"He didn't aim to help us, Bianca. The space just got torn in the aftermath of his fight with that madman. Ha, anyway, I have to request a proper information sharing from Lord Jin in the future. It's certain that he opened Temar's tomb."
[Cough... Cough!]
As Orgal entered the conference room coughing, everyone saluted him in unison.
"Oh, why did our lord bring this dying body here again... If you had stayed put, we would have gone to report."
[I... I have... good... cough! News.]
"Good news?"
As Zephyrin tilted her head, a smile spread across the leader's dim face.
[Didn't you, cough, feel anything, Zephyrin, when you saw Bale, the being awakened from Temar's tomb.]
Zephyrin's eyes slowly widened at Orgal's question. Soon, she understood what her master's words meant.
"Don't tell me... Are you saying that that madman is a trace of life?"
When the leader nodded, Zephyrin reflexively shut her mouth. It was a reaction stemming from her irreverence for calling the 'trace of life' a madman.
"My goodness. It seems that the moment Jin Runcandel actually helped us has arrived!"
One of the beings Kinzelo had long sought after, a key to their grand undertaking, was Bale, a trace of life.
Even though Orgal hadn't seen Bale directly, he was certain. He had felt that unique energy from the moment Bale woke up and started wielding his power.
Also, the history manipulation that Bale released simultaneously with Runcandel's awakening included some of the history about Orgal.
This meant that Orgal's powers would return at a faster rate.
[Zephyrin.]
"Speak, my lord."
[Jin, cough! May learn about Bale sooner than we expect. Cough, we need to act before he learns about the contract and the Oath.]
"Understood. However, he tends to be obsessed with a character named Sarah. What should we do?"
[We have to create something that can replace Sarah Runcandel... Hmm, it won't be that difficult. She was originally pure, and she's probably hurt.]
"Is there a possibility that he has already made a contract? I did see him fighting before we returned. He might have eliminated it."

[If a contract is already in place, we will again be at a disadvantage to Jin. Cough! Since I can feel the energy of life, it can't have been eliminated. Cough. Moreover, Jin Runcandel has a lot to learn from him. Even if he was pushed back in the battle with Jin, Bale would not have been unable to escape.]
At the part about being at a disadvantage, Zephyrin paused to reflect for a moment.
"...I will go to Tikan immediately to assess the situation."
[If Bale is not in Tikan, release the search party, and if he's with Jin, bring him here with utmost care.]
Regrettably, what Zephyrin saw when she found Tikan was Bale, who had already completed the contract and imposed the Oath on himself.
Unlike when he first woke up, Bale now looked like an ordinary human.
The shining ring above his head and the two large, white wings were gone, and his cross-shaped eyes were no different from those of an ordinary person.
Only his golden hair gave off a faint, spiritual light, indicating that he was not an ordinary being.
"Bale, bring me some snacks over here. Let's eat together."
"...Alright."
Sandra was treating this divine being like a younger brother, doting on him.
Bale, with a dark complexion, brought some snacks placed on the table.
Since Sandra acknowledged the fact that she was not Sarah, Bale wanted to tear her apart right then and there, but there was no way he could do it.
The contract and the Oath were absolute. Bale's current state was that of a slave, completely dependent on Sandra.
"You can feed me one every five seconds. Got it? You can eat on your own."
"Understood."
"You're too stiff. Can't you give a more friendly response?"
"I'll try."
"Hmm, good."
The way Sandra dealt with Bale was a scene not yet familiar even to Jin and his comrades in Tikan.
So, as the executives who had come to escort him from Kinzelo, they could not help but be astounded.
"...Jin, what on earth is going on?"
"It's a headache. Can't you tell by looking?"
"How dare that crazy bio-golem, considering who he is."
Sandra hummed a tune while chewing on the snack Bale gave her. Seeing Zephyrin maintain decorum the moment she saw Bale, she was deliberately being irritating.
Zephyrin sighed deeply and once again bowed her head to Bale.
"Lord Bale, I'm Zephyrin, the Grand Duke of the Demon World. As I mentioned earlier, my lord has something to tell you, so he asked me to bring you..."
"Bale, get rid of that demon dragon. It's annoying."
"Do you mean to kill it?"
"Of course."
Chi-!
As soon as the command was given, Bale began to transform back into his original form, but Jin stopped Sandra.
"Sandra."
"Tsk. Stop, Bale."
"Understood."
"Affection!"
"Got it..."
"Damn it! Lord Bale, why on earth did you make a contract with that bio-golem?"
"Hey, demon dragon. Is that attitude right? You're polite to Bale but treat me like a lower being? Should I tell Bale to never cooperate with you guys? I mean, show some respect."
In the end, Zephyrin dragged Jin outside.
"Jin, that bio-golem listens to you very well. I can't stand this humiliation anymore. I will formally request you as an ally. Please allow us to escort Lord Bale."
"Sandra isn't my subordinate, Zephyrin. And what do you think you guys are doing?"
"Did you forget that my lord helped you save Hister not too long ago? It's not a difficult request. If you're worried we might act recklessly, you're welcome to accompany us."
If it was unbelievable that Bale was subordinate to Sandra, it was interesting to see Kinzelo suddenly show up and become obsessed with Bale.
He had a feeling that if he played his cards right, he could use Kinzelo to ensure Hedo and Sandra's safety.
"Zephyrin, I honestly thought if you guys came, you would ask for compensation for damage or to share information about Bale. But what's the reason for showing such attitude openly? Answer honestly."
"...Fine. We already knew about Bale's contract and the Oath. So, we tried to make a contract first without you knowing, but the bio-golem beat us to it."
"Ah, so you didn't consider the possibility that Bale would make a contract with Sandra, not me."
"That's correct. To us, as I'm sure is the case for you, Bale is a very important entity."
"Is it because of the entity called the 'Parent of Life' that Orgal mentioned?"
Jin thought that the only target that Kinzelo would obsess over so openly was that one. From what he learned in the first meeting, Kinzelo's goal seemed to be deeply related to the Parent of Life.
'I suspected that was why he gave me information about Zipple's sanctuary.'
-Even if I don't have a Contract of Truth, I don't plan on lying, Jin Runcandel. The reason the world is in this state is because the Parent of Life has perished.
Probably, the 'purification' that Kinzelo talks about includes the process of resurrecting the Parent of Life.
'Kinzelo is trying to resurrect the Parent of Life, and the Prophet is trying to bring about the Second Coming of Helrum...'
Their goals seemed to be at odds. Those who seek to purify the world and those who seek to plunge it into chaos.
Of course, to Jin's eyes, all of them looked like madmen who kept tormenting a perfectly fine world. Just like Zipple, who tries to manipulate history and move the world according to their will.
Kinzelo may use nice words like purification, but in the end, they resorted to terror, murder, and various evil deeds. The Prophet and Zipple go without saying.
And Rosa is trying to completely destroy the world amidst all this. As he thought up to that point, a headache hit Jin.
"That's correct. We want to resurrect the Parent of Life, and Bale is an important clue for that."
"You confess very frankly."

"We're allies, even if temporarily. Bale is also related to the recovery of my master. Isn't it necessary for you too to maximize the recovery of the master before the final battle with Rosa Runcandel?"
He was right. That's why Jin was concerned about Orgal's recovery during the first meeting.
He had to meet with Orgal anyway. He had to let him know that Rosa's power seemed to be growing faster than he expected.
"Even without Bale, Orgal himself has already stated that there are other means to accelerate recovery in the worst-case scenario."
"So, you're saying you can't cooperate?"
"No, let's cooperate. But I want to propose a condition."
"Ah, that annoying condition. What is it?"
"Protection for Sandra and the Tower Keeper. You must have caught a glimpse at Temar's tomb, but they will be treated as traitors if they go back to Zipple now."

"Why not just not send them back? While Zipple might be highly offended, they can't outright oppose you with the final battle against Rosa looming. Their failure to manage people properly is their own fault."

"I don't intend to send them back. There will be no problem with them being important forces even if they betrayed us until the final battle, but just in case, I'm asking for your protection as well. The more hands, the better."
Surprisingly, Zephyrin complied smoothly with Jin's request.

"We have no choice but to protect the biological golem as long as Bale is here. Plus, protecting the Tower Keeper is almost laughably easy, so your condition is surprisingly conscientious. I'll accept it."
